query: SELECT cc.classificacao, cc.divisor, SUM(ls.valor) as total FROM lancamento_salario ls JOIN conta_custo cc ON ls.contaCustoId = cc.id JOIN periodo_custo pc ON ls.periodoCustoId = pc.id WHERE pc.mes = 4 AND pc.ano = 2026 GROUP BY cc.classificacao, cc.divisor;
